title: Enterprise Vector Index Zero-Downtime Embedding Model Migration, Orthogonal Procrustes Adapter & Blue-Green Cutover

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Stop-the-World Index Drop + On-Demand GPU Re-Embedding
tiers.architecture: Taking RAG search offline while re-embedding 250M chunks on On-Demand GPUs and rebuilding HNSW graph from scratch

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Naive In-Place Mixed-Model Vector Upsert (No Space Alignment)
tiers.architecture: Switching query encoder to v2 immediately while lazily overwriting v1 document vectors in the same HNSW index

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Full Dual-RAM HNSW Shadow Index + Synchronous Dual-Encoder Write
tiers.architecture: Provisioning 2x full RAM HNSW clusters for 14 days while re-embedding 250M chunks on On-Demand GPUs

tiers.tier: Tier 4: Orthogonal Procrustes Query Bridge + DiskANN/MRL Shadow Backfill on Spot GPUs + Atomic Alias Swap
tiers.architecture: SVD Orthogonal Procrustes Projection (W* = U V^T on 50K anchors) + Off-Peak Spot GPU Backfill + Kafka CDC Watermark + Shadow Recall Gate

scenarios.scenario: Instant Day-0 Query Compatibility via SVD Orthogonal Procrustes Linear Adapter ($W^* = U V^T$)
scenarios.question: Decommission deprecated cloud Embedding API v1 within 24 hours across 250M vectors before full corpus re-embedding can finish
scenarios.model_answer: Sample 50,000 representative anchor chunks, compute SVD of cross-covariance X_v2^T X_v1 = U Sigma V^T, and deploy orthogonal matrix W* = U V^T at query gateway to project new v2 query vectors into legacy v1 HNSW space (0.4% recall drop, 0.0 min downtime)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 2 queries v1 document vectors directly with unprojected v2 query vectors -> cosine similarity collapses to random noise (71.0% Recall@10 drop)!

scenarios.scenario: 250M-Chunk Background Re-Embedding via Content-Hash Dedup & Off-Peak Spot GPU Batching
scenarios.question: Re-embed 250M enterprise document chunks (125B tokens) into `BGE-M3 / Text-Embedding-3-Large` without blowing the cloud GPU budget
scenarios.model_answer: Deduplicate identical boilerplate chunks by SHA-256 content hash (-38% redundant chunks) and run TensorRT-FP8 dynamic-batch backfill on off-peak Spot GPUs into NVMe-backed DiskANN/SQ8 shadow index ($29K total TCO)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 & Tier 3 re-embed all 250M raw chunks (including 38% duplicate headers/disclaimers) via synchronous On-Demand APIs while paying 100% double RAM HNSW cost ($92K–$146K).

scenarios.scenario: Zero-Loss Live Document Updates During 7-Day Backfill via Kafka CDC Dual-Write Watermark
scenarios.question: While the 250M historical backfill runs over 7 days, 1.2M live document edits/deletions arrive from SharePoint and Confluence
scenarios.model_answer: Record Kafka CDC offset watermark `T_start`; dual-write live updates to both v1 and v2 indexes with `(doc_id, version_ts)` upsert guards so historical backfill never overwrites newer live edits (0.0% stale delta miss)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 snapshot backfill overwrites live mid-week document edits with stale Monday snapshot vectors (12.4% stale delta miss rate).

scenarios.scenario: Shadow Dark-Read `NDCG@10` Verification & Atomic Collection Alias Cutover
scenarios.question: Verify that the new v2 shadow index strictly outperforms v1 across all 12 business domains before switching production traffic
scenarios.model_answer: Fork 5% dark-read shadow queries + Cross-Encoder reranker judge; verify Recall@10/NDCG@10 gain (+6.8 pts) and zero ACL drift before executing sub-millisecond atomic collection alias swap `rag_prod -> index_v2`
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 2 cuts over blindly without dark-read validation, discovering domain-specific retrieval regressions only after customer complaints spike.

key_findings: Tier 4 (SVD Orthogonal Procrustes Query Bridge + SHA-256 Deduplicated Spot-GPU Backfill + Kafka CDC Version Watermark + Atomic Alias Cutover) achieves 0.0 minutes of RAG downtime and keeps transition Recall@10 drop to 0.4%.

Fitting an Orthogonal Procrustes transformation matrix (W* = U V^T) on 50,000 anchor pairs allows a new v2 query encoder to search legacy v1 document vectors immediately while background re-embedding proceeds.

Combining SHA-256 chunk deduplication (-38% redundant work) with off-peak Spot GPU TensorRT-FP8 batching and DiskANN/SQ8 staging cuts total migration TCO from $146K (Tier 1) and $92K (Tier 3) to $29K (-80.1%).
